question: India launched the Mission Innovation Clean-Tech Exchange in the Global Summit hosted by __ __ in 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Chile.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• At **Chile's Net Zero Summit, India introduced the Mission Innovation Clean-Tech Exchange**. It is a global project that will build a network of incubators throughout member nations to hasten the **development of renewable energy technologies.**
 
• The **second phase of the worldwide Mission Innovation effort,** known as **Mission Innovation 2.0, was introduced at the 2015 **UN climate summit during the **Paris Agreement.**
 
• An **ambitious new initiative called Mission Innovation 2.0 **has been unveiled by the **governments of 23 countries, including India,** in an effort to spur action and lead a decade of **innovation for increased global investment **in clean energy research, development, and **demonstrations. **​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **worldwide Mission Innovation initiative's second phase,** known as **Mission Innovation 2.0,** was introduced during the 2015 COP21 meeting with the** Paris Agreement. **The new programme was introduced during the** Chilean-hosted Innovating to Net Zero Summit.**
 
• In this decade, we want to** accelerate progress toward the Paris Agreement,** make renewable energy more appealing, affordable, and accessible, and **pursue Net-zero routes.**
 
• To** boost confidence and awareness **in emerging ideas and maximise the impact of national investments, a number of new Missions will be undertaken under this** new MI 2.0, supported by a new global Innovation Platform. **
